implementation.basisRelease: Every plan exit, including prepared, verified and failed exits, deletes the corresponding playerSnapshots WeakMap entry and sets session.basis to null.
implementation.conflictEvidence: session.reads and session.record remain available after a prepared proposal until conflict checking/commit or the next plan.
implementation.newPlanAndCleanup: Superseded read and record copies are retired before new snapshot allocation; terminated session cleanup retires all three snapshot owners.
implementation.retainedIdentity: ctx, transaction, GM/P identity, generation, signal and budgets are not removed or bypassed.
